title: Choose the visual world for Bombay Palace
question: The roll assigned The Painted Menu Board. Keep it, take my pick or the category standard, or re-roll. All three stay light, ivory-based and photo-led, as your brief requires.

options.label: The Painted Menu Board
options.lineage: Bombay's hand-painted café and street-cart menu boards
options.thesis: The whole site reads like Bombay's signwritten menu boards: confident lettering, prices in a straight painted column, food photos doing the colour.
options.viewport: Ivory page. A large bright spread of dishes fills the right 7 columns; on the left, the name in sign lettering, one line 'Indian cuisine on Macon Road, Columbus, Georgia', Explore the menu (saffron) and Get directions (ink outline).
options.risk: Sign lettering turns kitsch if it's set too large or used beyond names and section titles.

raised.raise: Every dish line is banded the same way, in a fixed order: name, short description, price on one painted column.
Literal wayfinding: sections are named plainly (Menu, Visit), so navigation is just reading.
Rank by inversion: one feature section alone turns forest-green; every other section stays on the ivory page.

options.label: Marine Drive Deco
options.lineage: Bombay's 1930s Art Deco facades on Marine Drive and the Oval
options.thesis: Bombay's Art Deco architecture as the frame: fine stepped linework, arched photo windows and ivory stucco.
options.viewport: Ivory facade. A tall arched window holds the hero dish photo; the name and the actions sit beside it under a thin stepped cornice line.
options.risk: The most familiar route: cream, a display serif and arches are where many restaurant sites land.

options.label: Pickling Brine Calendar
options.thesis: Dishes as labelled jars on a seasonal shelf.
options.viewport: A shelf of jars, one per category.
options.case: Fuses poorly: pickling isn't this restaurant's story and hides the menu behind a metaphor.
options.kept: Every item banded with the same facts in the same order.

options.label: Industrial Quote Grammar
options.thesis: Every zone named literally in quotes.
options.viewport: Giant quoted caps over white cotton.
options.case: Fuses poorly: cold and fashion-coded for a warm dining invitation.

options.label: Depot Destination Blind
options.thesis: Content stepping under one fixed window.
options.viewport: One lit window of green cloth.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a monitoring form with no link to the food.
options.kept: Rank by inversion: only one panel turns dark.

options.label: Village Coffeehouse Identity
options.thesis: Woodcut mark over torn kraft paper.
options.viewport: A stamped sun over torn kraft.
options.case: Fuses poorly: torn edges and kraft are the muddy-brown look the brief rules out.

options.label: Saturday Title Card
options.thesis: A starburst logotype card per section.
options.viewport: A starburst with a bowed logotype.
options.case: Fuses poorly: loud novelty against an elegant brief.
options.kept: One hub per viewport where the eye lands.

options.label: Oscilloscope Bench
options.thesis: A phosphor trace over a graticule.
options.case: Fuses poorly: dark lab equipment, the opposite of the brief.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A full-bleed food photo with the name centred over it, then cream sections below, executed with care.
canonCard.viewport: A full-screen dish photo with a dark overlay, the name centred, two buttons beneath.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other Indian restaurant site.
